blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ABS-CBN artists Carmelle and BINI brought pride to the Philippines with three major international victories over the weekend, as Carmelle made history as the first-ever champion of “Eurovision Song Contest Asia,” while BINI scored wins at the 2026 Nickelodeon Kids’ Choice Awards and the 2nd Jupiter Music Awards. The back-to-back victories highlight the growing global recognition of Filipino performing talent and ABS-CBN’s continued expansion into the international entertainment market. “These victories are a proud moment not just for ABS-CBN, but for the entire country.
